summary: Separate generated read codecs from mutation and PTY validators

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No wire or storage schema changes; generated TypeScript validators are partitioned by read dependencies.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: Existing client exports remain available with identical read validator instances. An additive schema/read entrypoint excludes mutation and PTY codecs.

downtime.detail: No service interruption or startup migration required.

manual.detail: No operator action or configuration change required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
